postAttachCommand.append_bashrc:
cd ${HOME} && printf "if [ -f ~/.bashrc_iCub ]; then
 . ~/.bashrc_iCub
fi" | cat - ~/.bashrc > temp && mv temp ~/.bashrc && source ~/.bashrc && cd -
postAttachCommand.set_obj_subdir:
cd ~ && printf "export OBJ_SUBDIR=build
" | cat - ~/.bashrc > temp && mv temp ~/.bashrc && source ~/.bashrc && cd -
